name: Yumemiru Sakura no Sotsugyoushiki
original_name: ゆめみるサクラの卒業式
source:
A graduation ceremony that breaks a little more with every loop.

Sakura, Shion, and Hina are about to graduate. It should have been just an ordinary day with these close friends. The story begins as you choose whether Sakura speaks to Shion or Hina first. The order you choose changes the conversations, letting you see the three girls' relationships from different angles.

A visual novel about a peaceful graduation ceremony... until, after talking with the two adorable girls, the screen cuts unnaturally to black and the game returns to the title screen. Play again, and the conversations begin to change. Those changes grow into something deeply wrong, and the repeating graduation turns into a nightmare. Why does the ceremony keep repeating? See the truth with your own eyes.

Her friends truly care about Sakura, the protagonist. And yet, the smiles are fading from their faces. The more you repeat the ceremony and listen to the three of them talk, the closer you get to the truth.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5292500]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一场每经历一次轮回就崩坏几分的毕业典礼。

樱、紫苑与雏即将迎来毕业。对于这群亲密好友而言，这本该只是平淡寻常的一天。故事从你选择让樱先去和紫苑还是雏搭话开始。不同的对话顺序会改变交谈内容，让你从不同角度窥见三名少女之间的关系。

这本是一部讲述温馨毕业典礼的视觉小说……直到与两名可爱的少女交谈过后，画面突兀地切入黑屏，游戏退回了标题界面。再次开始游戏，对话却悄然发生了变化。这些异变逐渐演变成令人毛骨悚然的违和感，不断重复的毕业典礼也随之化作一场噩梦。典礼为何会周而复始？请亲眼见证背后的真相吧。

朋友们明明真心关切着身为女主角的樱，脸上的笑容却在一点点消失。越是反复经历这场毕业典礼、倾听三人的交谈，你就越接近真相。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5292500]Steam[/url]]
